intro.welcomeMessage: Join us as we celebrate the making of our marriage covenant and our union, surrended by people we love most. We can't wait to share this unforgettable day with you!

items.question: Can I bring a plus one?
items.answer: As we are keeping our celebration intimate and within a comfortable capacity, we have carefully planned our guest list. Your invitation will indicate if your plus-one has been included. We appreciate your understanding.

items.question: What time should I arrive?
items.answer: Please be seated by 10.15am, as we will commence the ceremony promptly. Guest arriving after this time may be seated after the walk-in has concluded.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer:
As parking is limited at the church, we would recommend parking at the following location: 
- United Square Shopping Mall (5-8mins walk)
- IRAS Revenus House (10mins walk)
- 37A Cambridge Rd, MSCP HDB (10-12mins walk)

items.question: Are children welcome?
items.answer: Yes! If your children's name is not included in the invite, please let us know. A cry room is available at the back of the hall. or a free-roaming space outside the hall for your use.
